summary.intent: Run compound engineering retrospectives to flow session learnings into core files, dogfood CAS cognitive routing via Lemonade local inference, build a multimodal agent journey rendering pipeline, and close the knowledge compound loop by fixing vault persistence and building cross-store search.
summary.outcome: Built and verified: CAS classifier adapter (21 tests, ~350ms/classify on Vulkan), Lemonade MCP server (13 tools), journey rendering pipeline (physics→LLM narration→TTS→sonification), KnowledgeOracle for cross-store search (9 tests), Stop hook for auto-persistence. Fixed vault MCP (FastMCP v1.26 ASGI breaking change), system Lemonade config (ROCm→Vulkan), and bashrc `set -i` errors. Pruned KEY_LEARNINGS 378→135 lines.

repo: Two Lemonade server instances run simultaneously: port 13306 (system, GPU Vulkan + CPU) and port 13307 (vendor/embedded, NPU FLM only). CAS classifier and all chat/TTS tools must target 13306.

System Lemonade config at /var/lib/lemonade/.cache/lemonade/config.json defaults to ROCm backend. Must run `sudo -u lemonade lemonade config set llamacpp.backend=vulkan` once or every load spawns stuck 100% CPU ROCm processes on gfx1151.

SurrealDB has 4 databases in cohezion namespace: vault (neurons/synapses), genesis (prompt_artifacts/universe_snapshots), main (vmodel_gate/traces), universe (mission_journey). HTTP access requires surreal-ns and surreal-db headers.

SurrealDB synapses store source/target as strings ('neurons:abc123') not record links (neurons:abc123). All relational queries silently return 0 matches. Must use string-cast comparisons or fix vault-keeper INSERT statements.
Qwen3-8B-GGUF returns empty string without `/no_think` prefix in the prompt. No error is raised — silent empty output.
gemma3-4b-FLM (NPU backend) returns `<pad>` tokens for chat prompts. FLM models are NPU-compiled for speed and lose instruction-following capability. Use for embeddings only, not chat.
FastMCP v1.26.0 breaking change: FastMCP object is no longer directly callable as ASGI. Must use `mcp.sse_app()` to get the ASGI handler. The health endpoint still works, masking the breakage.
`lemonade pull` via API only registers model metadata — does not download checkpoint files. `lemonade` CLI binary actually downloads. Use CLI for initial model acquisition.

sd-cpp binary ships without libstable-diffusion.so in its RPATH. Binary works with `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/path/to/sd-cpp/lib` set manually, but Lemonade spawns it without this — all image generation fails silently.

KEY_LEARNINGS.md compression pattern: individual L### entries (3-10 lines each) can be grouped into session blocks as single-line summaries while preserving all learning numbers for grep discoverability. 378→135 lines at 64% reduction.

code.finding: Three blocks appended by prior automated sessions using `set -i` (invalid — only valid at shell invocation, not as set builtin). Removed entirely; the original guard at lines 6-9 already handles non-interactive shells correctly.
FastMCP v1.26 ASGI fix: `mcp_app = mcp` → `mcp_app = mcp.sse_app()`. The old direct-call interface was removed in v1.26.0. Health endpoint worked but all 56 MCP tools returned 500.

New file: sync adapter routing tasks through CAS cognitive faculties via Lemonade. Maps 10 faculties to 3 TaskProfiles. Collects (task, faculty, confidence) training triples. Includes pad-token filter for FLM models and 2-second timeout with keyword fallback.
Added CAS-first classification path: if CASClassifier is available, calls it before keyword logic. Falls back silently on timeout or None result.
Replaced no-op stub with live Lemonade-backed narrator. Uses Qwen3-8B on port 13306 with /no_think prefix. Async narrate() calls Kokoro TTS. Falls back gracefully when Lemonade unavailable.

New file: fans out single query to vault search, SurrealDB neuron full-text, and KEY_LEARNINGS grep in parallel. Merges and ranks by relevance score. Returns ConsolidatedAnswer with provenance per result.
New Stop hook: flushes CAS training data to JSONL, persists session summary to SurrealDB prompt_artifacts, logs new learnings to vault. First run captured 7 artifacts automatically.

workflow: When a model returns silent empty output (no error), check for required prompt prefixes before debugging the model itself — Qwen3 requires `/no_think` and FLM models require non-chat prompts.
Test with `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` manually before concluding a binary is broken — RPATH bugs are common in packaged ML binaries and easy to rule out.
SurrealDB health endpoint success does not imply application-level functionality — always test actual tool calls, not just /health, when diagnosing MCP servers.

When investigating port/process confusion, check `ss -tlnp` and `ps aux | grep <service>` together — multiple instances of the same service on different ports are common in dev environments with both system and embedded service variants.
Graph HIHO queries returning 0.000 despite data existing is a type system issue, not missing data — verify field types before assuming connectivity is broken.
API 500 errors at end of long sessions indicate context size limits, not code bugs — start fresh sessions and rely on the knowledge compound (MEMORY.md, KnowledgeOracle) to restore context.
